parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

1
accent[æksent]n.
An accent is a certain way of speaking that shows where a person is from. (giọng, chất giọng)
➔ The new teacher's accent was clearly a German one.
2
barber[barbər]n.
A barber is a person whose job is to cut hair. (thợ cắt tóc)
➔ My hair is getting much too long. I'd better go to the barber's shop.
3
basement[beismənt]n.
A basement of a house or building is a room that is built underground. (tầng hầm)
➔ They turned their basement into a game room.
4
blank[blænk]adj.
When something is blank, it does not have anything on it. (trống, để trắng)
➔ She got a blank paper to draw on.
5
blink[bliŋk]v.
To blink means to shut the eyes and quickly open them again. (chớp mắt)
➔ I blinked many times so that my eyes could adjust to the bright light.
6
choir[kwaiər]n.
A choir is a group of people who sing together. (dàn hợp xướng)
➔ He had choir practice every day after school.
7
comic[kamik]adj.
When something is comic, it is funny. (hài hước)
➔ The comic actor was famous for his jokes.
8
complicate[kamplikeit]v.
To complicate something means to make it harder than necessary. (làm phức tạp)
➔ The bad weather complicated finishing the job quickly.
9
decline[diklain]v.
To decline an offer or invitation means to say no to it. (từ chối)
➔ She declined his offer to pay for her dinner.
10
errand[erənd]n.
An errand is a trip taken to do a specific activity. (việc vặt)
➔ He couldn't go to practice because he had several errands to do.
11
glove[glʌv]n.
A glove is a piece of clothing that covers your fingers and hand. (găng tay)
➔ When it gets cold, I always put on a pair of gloves.
12
hermit[hərmit]n.
A hermit is one who lives alone and does not spend time with others. (người ẩn dật)
➔ The hermit lived a simple life in a small cave in the forest.
13
justly[ʤʌstli]adv.
If something is done justly, then it is fair. (một cách công bằng)
➔ We justly decided to give the prize to him.
14
leather[leðər]n.
Leather is a material made from animal skin that is used to make clothing. (da)
➔ He got a new leather jacket for his birthday.
15
ponder[pandər]v.
To ponder something is to think about it carefully. (suy nghĩ, cân nhắc)
➔ She sat in the park and pondered her problem.
16
reserve[rizərv]v.
To reserve something means to keep it for a certain person or time. (đặt trước, dành trước)
➔ He reserved a table at the busy restaurant.
17
script[skript]n.
A script is the words of a film or play. (kịch bản)
➔ He read the script of the play three times.
18
search[sərʧ]v.
To search for something or someone means to look for them carefully. (tìm kiếm)
➔ I searched the newspaper for a new job.
19
slam[slæm]v.
To slam is to close something hard. (đóng sầm)
➔ She slammed the book shut after she finished reading it.
20
staircase[steərkeis]n.
A staircase is a set of stairs found inside a building. (cầu thang)
➔ The staircase leads directly into the kitchen.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The School Play

Peter was excited. Next week he was going to audition for the school play. Everybody knew he was a great actor. He was sure he would get the lead role.

Later, his friend Robby asked him, "Have you seen the script for the play?"

"Yes. The title is The Lost Glove—it's a comic play," replied Peter.

Robby said, "I want to play the part of the hermit because the hermit gets to talk with an accent!"

"I want the lead role of the barber. I didn't know you liked acting. I thought you liked choir better," said Peter.

"Acting is also a hobby of mine. Do you want to practice with me? The basement at my house is quiet. It's perfect!" Robby replied.

"I don't like practicing with others. It complicates the process for me," said Peter.

Actually, Peter didn't want to practice at all. The teacher would surely reserve the lead part for him. A few days later, Robby came to his house.

Robby said, "Do you want to practice the scene on the staircase? It's the part where the migrant searches for a new job."

Peter declined the invitation. "I can't today. I need to do some errands." Then he slammed the door. It was just an excuse. Peter didn't want to help Robby.

On the day of auditions, Peter wore his lucky leather jacket. He always got the best part when he wore it. The teacher told him to begin, but his mind was blank. He couldn't remember the lines!

A week later, the teacher put a list of the parts on the wall. Peter read the list, looking for his name. He was shocked by what he saw. He blinked his eyes and looked again. He didn't get the lead part—Robby did! Peter pondered the situation and came to the idea that Robby justly received the part. He earned it by practicing. Next time, Peter would practice, too!

sections.title: Reading Comprehension Part A
sections.content: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: The title of the script was The Big Barber.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Trong bài viết: "The title is The Lost Glove—it's a comic play," kịch bản có tên The Lost Glove, không phải The Big Barber.

questions.content: Robby wanted the part of the hermit because he would get to talk with an accent.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Robby nói: "I want to play the part of the hermit because the hermit gets to talk with an accent!"

questions.content: Robby declined Peter's offer to practice together.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Sự thật là Peter từ chối lời mời của Robby, chứ không phải Robby từ chối Peter.

questions.content: The scene on the staircase was about the migrant searching for a new job.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Robby nói: "Do you want to practice the scene on the staircase? It's the part where the migrant searches for a new job."

questions.content: Peter's mind was blank during the audition.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Bài đọc viết: "The teacher told him to begin, but his mind was blank."

questions.content: Peter felt that Robby justly received the lead role.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Bài đọc viết: "Peter pondered the situation and came to the idea that Robby justly received the part."
